triage.brief:
Triage GitHub issue {{repo}}#{{number}}. The issue is in {{evidence}}/read-1/answer.json. Do not change any code.

1. Reproduce it if you can, and say exactly how (commands, what you saw).
2. Look for duplicates among the repository's open and closed issues.
3. Suggest a severity and why.

Write all of it to {{evidence}}/triage.md. Say what you checked and what you only suspect.

scope.ask: Work on {{repo}}#{{number}}? Read the triage first. Approve to look for the root cause, send triage back with what to check, or stop.

root-cause.brief:
Find the root cause of GitHub issue {{repo}}#{{number}} (issue: {{evidence}}/read-1/answer.json, triage: {{evidence}}/triage.md). Do not change any code.

Name the layer and the code that causes it, with evidence (file and line, a log, a failing command). Then plan the fix: what changes where, what it must not change, and how it is verified, including a test that fails before the fix and passes after.

Write it to {{evidence}}/plan.md.

plan.ask: Fix {{repo}}#{{number}} as planned? Approve, send it back with what is wrong, or stop.

fix.brief:
Fix GitHub issue {{repo}}#{{number}} following the approved plan in {{evidence}}/plan.md.

Work on branch loop/issue-{{number}} from {{base}}. Add the test the plan names, and show it failing before the fix and passing after. Run `{{test}}` and make it pass without loosening any check. Commit on the branch. Do not push and do not open a pull request: both happen only after the user approves the fix.

Write to {{evidence}}/fix.md what you changed, the commits, and the output of every test you ran. If any test you ran still fails, say so in the first line. If earlier test runs failed, their output is under {{evidence}} (tests-N/stderr.txt).

stuck.ask: Tests on {{repo}}#{{number}} still fail after three fixes. Send it back to the fix or the root cause with what to change, or stop.

accept.ask: The fix for {{repo}}#{{number}} is committed on branch loop/issue-{{number}} (not pushed yet), and the check `{{test}}` passed. Read fix.md for what else was run and how it went. Approve to push the branch and open a pull request into {{base}}, send it back, or stop.

args.head: loop/issue-{{number}}
args.title: Fix #{{number}}
args.body: Fixes #{{number}}. Root cause, plan and test results were reviewed at each step before this pull request was opened.

merged.ask: Approve once the pull request for {{repo}}#{{number}} is merged. The issue stays open until a release with the fix is verified.
